verdict.rationale: Otter AI Chat accepts natural-language questions across meetings, connected apps and CRMs, and can draft follow-ups, reports and content. The MCP server also lets Claude and ChatGPT search, recap and draft follow-ups from Otter data through chat. However, the evidence covers natural-language querying and content generation, not operating the product itself, such as scheduling the notetaker, managing channels or changing settings by command. Missing for 10: evidence of natural-language commands that perform product actions or configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of AI Chat or MCP command quality.
